clock: now: monotonically increasing ISO instant, UTC

responses: Successful mutations: {ok:true,...}; reasoned refusals: {ok:false,reason,...}. Booking refusal includes immutable decision and policyVersion.
time: Named occurrence date/start/end are UTC calendar coordinates. Clock defaults to live time; controlled clock is available per house for operations. Read or mutation applies due expiry/lapse transitions.
persistence: One atomically replaced JSON booking record in impl/data.json; single Node process serializes all decision mutations. LOYLY_DATA may select another file inside impl.
roles: This local operator console records configured acting roles; it does not authenticate identities or integrate an identity provider.
billing: Signals only; amounts are resolved by the configured billing role using house price references. No payment collection or proceeds distribution.
heater: Derived operations schedule only, no network equipment control.
